name: New Star Investment Trust Plc
summary: New Star Investment Trust plc (NSI.L) operates as a closed-end investment company, specifically a balanced "fund of funds," with its management entrusted to Brompton Asset Management LLP. The trust's strategy involves allocating its capital to other investment vehicles that, in turn, invest in publicly traded equities across global markets. Its highly diversified portfolio spans a broad range of asset classes, including shares, fixed income, commodities, real estate, and currencies. It also utilizes various financial instruments such as pooled investment vehicles, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), futures, options, and limited partnerships, aiming for exposure to companies across numerous sectors. The performance of its investments is measured against the FTSE All-Share Total Return Index. New Star Investment Trust plc was established in the United Kingdom on April 5, 2000.
